rationale: The change updates the interface that supplies obstacle information to the observable representation, while the evaluation target, phenomenon of interest, object-category scheme, and ego-object spatial relation remain unchanged. In the baseline, H1-ORR1 depends on H1-A1, whose revalidation condition H1-RC1 is triggered when the obstacle-detection requirements, architectural responsibility for obstacle information, or the information supplied for representing obstacle presence changes. This change directly affects the obstacle-presence information interface, so only H1-ORR1 must be revalidated.
